source_evidence: Player exact 'What are the conditions for Hereditary recovery grant?' authorizes clarification of preliminary offer only. At V's request the Crown land-disposition officer clarifies the proposed no-purchase-price hereditary recovery grant: (1) secure the abandoned service house and immediate Crown-held grounds against actual dangerous occupants/conditions, by removing, containing or safely isolating genuine threats; no requirement to eradicate every creature in surrounding countryside or rebuild the whole ruin; (2) preserve the ferrier household's existing occupied dwelling, access, landing and return-channel usage rights, remedy any damage directly caused by the recovery; no forced tenancy, eviction or allegiance; preserve existing public access rights where applicable, no toll authority conferred; (3) identify the actual Crown-held parcel and demonstrate agreed safety/access conditions have been fulfilled to a competent Crown representative through practical inspection or adequate evidence, ordinary officials/staff handle routine recording with no additional arbitrary clerical rolls. No advance purchase price, bond, rent, compulsory service, fixed completion deadline or minimum capital investment proposed; ordinary applicable property law/tax obligations unaffected, no special exemption promised. Restoration beyond genuine safety work optional. Written conditional authority and exact scope to be agreed and competently authorized before fieldwork if V wishes; hereditary title and ordinary lawful use/improvement rights follow fulfillment and recording, not merely exploration or ancient ancestry claim. No promise of disputed historical artifacts, water monopoly, occupied dwelling or unspecified surrounding acreage. This is a clarified preliminary proposal not an accepted/signed grant; V has not agreed to acquisition or expedition and no money spent. Terms are newly adjudicated in-world proposed conditions consistent with D326 prior options and existing estate recovery grant precedents; no ownership, application, spending, expedition or roll. All prior counters and commitments unchanged.
